scope: Static source support for the exact-image runtime comparison; runtime remains the semantic authority

c_raw_scan.behavior: Every C_IN query scans daemon->rr; type or ANY first, then hostname_isequal; list order is preserved.

c_name_comparison.behavior: Length equality and ASCII A-Z case folding; no allocation or wire-name conversion.

main_tcp.behavior: Both debug and connection snapshot branches return a cache hit before calling local_tcp_answer/tcp_view_local_answer.

change.behavior: Raw lookup receives the original dotted name and compares eq_ignore_ascii_case only after type selection. Raw no longer requests a dotted_key. Reverse declaration iteration, TTL and output data are unchanged; no index added.

limits: C/main absolute TCP difference includes architecture and connection costs, not only semantic local lookup.
The 100-to-1000 difference measures configuration sensitivity in the full daemon; it is not an isolated per-record microbenchmark.
